summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against all fifteen source paragraphs, including their notes and metadata. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the household warning, wholehearted repentance, angelic justification, prayer’s lack of usefulness, spirit departure, incurable sin, and concluding commands without doctrinal additions or weakened negation. Servant terminology follows current policy. The revised abundance and neglect renderings are source-compatible on fresh review. The disclosed alternatives remain distinct from the selected working readings, and the notes identify the reported editorial insertion of “now.” Acceptance is limited to fidelity to the supplied working source and disclosure of the supplied comparison reports; it does not authenticate unseen editions or manuscript images, certify exhaustive collation, or establish a unique interpretation.
